      PRODUCT_USAGE_SQL
      "WITH usage_events AS (\n SELECT mi.ingredient_id, COUNT(*)::numeric AS units_used\n FROM customer_order co\n JOIN order_item oi ON oi.order_id = co.order_id\n JOIN menu_inventory mi ON mi.menu_id = oi.item_id\n WHERE co.timestamp >= ? AND co.timestamp < ?\n GROUP BY mi.ingredient_id\n UNION ALL\n SELECT oit.topping_id AS ingredient_id, COALESCE(SUM(oit.amount), 0) AS units_used\n FROM customer_order co\n JOIN order_item_toppings oit ON oit.order_id = co.order_id\n WHERE co.timestamp >= ? AND co.timestamp < ?\n GROUP BY oit.topping_id\n)\nSELECT i.name AS product, ROUND(SUM(ue.units_used), 2) AS units_used\nFROM usage_events ue\nJOIN inventory i ON i.id = ue.ingredient_id\nGROUP BY i.id, i.name\nORDER BY units_used DESC, product\n"
      private static final int
